Unibind Technologies Limited

Package. Present. Preserve.

Document packaging systems, covers and implementation. Lagos, Nigeria, since 1993.

The company

1993.

Unibind Technologies Limited has supplied document packaging systems in Nigeria since 1993, as the exclusive Nigerian distributor of Peleman Industries of Belgium, a manufacturer of document packaging systems and covers operating since 1939, originally under the name Unibind, and present in more than 120 countries today.

What changed.

For most of that time, the system was sold on its own. It is now sold as a standard: an installed, written, trained way of finishing the official paper records an organisation produces. The work includes the workflow assessment, the written house standard and the training, so the result can be repeated by the people who prepare the records.

What we are building.

CDIS is the standard. The objective is that an organisation's important records look the same, survive the same, and can be produced again the same way, regardless of who in the building prepared them.

The timeline

  1. 1939

    Peleman Industries begins.

    Document packaging engineered in Belgium, originally under the name Unibind. Today it operates in more than 120 countries.

  2. 1993

    Unibind Technologies Limited, Lagos.

    The exclusive Nigerian distributorship begins. Systems, covers and implementation, supplied and supported locally.

  3. 2007

    The Nigerian Judicial Institute.

    Eddy Okeke .N. introduces Peleman document technology to the Nigerian Judicial Institute.

  4. 2026

    CDIS.

    The standard is operationalised as the Corporate Document Integrity System: assessment, installation, training and a written house standard.
